sections.h2: What Destiny Hills homes are like
paragraphs: Destiny Hills is different from the gated golf communities nearby. It is acreage, with lots of 2.9 acres and up, and the Ranches at Destiny Hills section has tracts up to 12.5 acres. There is no HOA, apart from a minimal one in the Ranches, and homes have individual gates. Houses start around 2,885 square feet, and prices run from about $900K to $2M.

Homes here are mostly custom one story plans, set back among trees on big lots. The mailing address says Austin, but you reach it off TX 71 near Bee Creek, in the same 78738 area as Lakeway. Long driveways, wide porches and big windows facing the trees are typical, with plenty of room between neighbors.

sections.h2: What Destiny Hills windows deal with
paragraphs: Tree cover is the defining condition. Oaks and cedars shade the lots, and they drop pollen, leaves and seeds onto the glass. Cedar pollen runs from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April. Spiders build in the eaves and window corners, and webs gather in the tracks. Dust also drifts in from long gravel or dirt drives, and rain splashes it up onto lower panes.

Wells and hoses give hard water on acreage, and lawn sprinklers leave white spots. Our dual RO, 4 stage pure water system with a DI resin tank gets water near 0 TDS, so glass dries with no spots and no soap film. Screens are $5 each, tracks are $5, and hard water spot removal is $10 per pane.

Each home has its own gate, so we ask you to text the address, the gate code or call box details, and any notes about dogs or livestock. Without a shared HOA gate, we work house by house. We carry 200 gallons of water on the 8 ft skid, which suits properties where a spigot may be far from the house. One story homes are easy to reach from the ground with water fed poles. Acreage often also means roofs, long driveways and patios. Roof soft wash starts at $0.25 per sq ft with a $400 minimum, and driveways are $0.18 per sq ft for concrete.

A typical 3,500 sq ft home here comes to about $350 for exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft. Exterior time is about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, so roughly three hours, plus about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft inside. Minimum job is $200. Lead time is usually within two weeks.
